question: After quotienting one overall adiabatic normalization and carrying C2 as an external gauge-invariant matching coordinate, how many independent finite-onset amplitudes remain in the corrected photon+baryon+massless-UR+neutral-Khronon completed-U1 O(k^2) coefficient system?

mandatory_separation.initial_amplitudes_z: regular O(k^0)+O(k^2) matter/multipole coefficients after eliminating algebraic preferred metric variables through A->Hamiltonian->momentum projection
mandatory_separation.derivatives_d: local conformal-time derivatives produced by the first-order hierarchy for each admissible z
mandatory_separation.rank_rule: only genuinely algebraic constraints/constitutive TCA closures may reduce nullity(z); equations d=Fz must not be counted as independent initial-amplitude constraints, per C10.65g
mandatory_separation.matching_coordinate: C2 is external/fixed during each nullity calculation and B0 is reconstructed from C2 rather than counted as an independent unknown
mandatory_separation.normalization: quotient exactly one common nonzero adiabatic normalization; do not set J_ad=0

physics_content.tca: use the source-locked compromise_CLASS low-k branch and the exact-onset C10.65f coefficient pack
physics_content.ur: retain massless-UR shear through O(k^2); F3=O(k^3) is outside this order
physics_content.metric: preferred finite-k DAE projector only; Newtonian physical potentials are outputs
physics_content.shift: B0=[C2+2 Pcal psi0-E_th phi0]/(2H); no independent chi/B0 state

required_outputs: explicit ordered list of initial-amplitude variables retained before and after algebraic elimination
explicit ordered list of independent algebraic constraints and their provenance
symbolic or exact-rational rank/nullity where possible, plus numerical SVD/rank cross-check at the frozen onset pack
nullity after removing one overall normalization with C2 held fixed
nullity with C2 released, to verify that the matching coordinate adds exactly the expected shift-sector boundary direction and does not masquerade as a propagating mode
basis vectors for every remaining null direction, classified as normalization, C2 matching, ordinary entropy/velocity, neutral relative entropy, hierarchy/multipole, or unresolved temporal branch
constraint residuals and preferred-projector denominator guards
repeat the structural count over the three frozen lambda_HL values; report any rank change rather than fitting it away

classification_rule.closed_given_C2: after normalization and fixed C2, nullity is zero; this means the finite-onset coefficient seed is algebraically determined conditional on the external matching scalar, but it is not by itself a growing-mode derivation
classification_rule.remaining_temporal_amplitudes: after normalization and fixed C2, nullity is positive; report its dimension and basis without inventing extra boundary conditions
classification_rule.rank_change: nullity/rank changes over the frozen lambda_HL grid or a preferred-projector denominator guard fails
classification_rule.technical_incomplete: the full source-locked TCA/UR/neutral algebraic ledger has not been encoded faithfully enough to make the count

forbidden_shortcuts: do not count d=Fz as a nullity-reducing snapshot constraint
do not import historical CLASS phi/psi as completed-U1 metric values
do not drop UR anisotropic stress at O(k^2)
do not assign a numerical C2 in this gate
next_if_closed_given_C2: select/test an explicit temporal or UV prescription for C2, construct the conditional completed-U1 seed, and run onset-shift plus forward finite-k Boltzmann controls
next_if_remaining_temporal_amplitudes: freeze the smallest additional gauge-invariant temporal boundary functional(s) indicated by the null basis before any spectra run
non_claims: not a UV value of C2
not a growing-mode theorem by snapshot rank
